<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="manifest-driven-ssmd-bundles">
<h1>Manifest-driven SSMD bundles</h1>
<p>UtterPlan’s bundle lifecycle accepts one canonical <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;name&gt;.ssmd-bundle/</span></code> root and dispatches from its <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">manifest.json</span></code>. Both compilation and projection use this entry point:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>utterplan<span class="w"> </span>bundle<span class="w"> </span>compile<span class="w"> </span>novel.ssmd-bundle<span class="w"> </span>--chapters<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">5</span>-17
utterplan<span class="w"> </span>bundle<span class="w"> </span>compile<span class="w"> </span>story.ssmd-bundle
utterplan<span class="w"> </span>bundle<span class="w"> </span>render<span class="w"> </span>novel.ssmd-bundle<span class="w"> </span>--chapters<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">5</span>-17<span class="w"> </span>--profile<span class="w"> </span>narration.renderprofile.toml
utterplan<span class="w"> </span>bundle<span class="w"> </span>render<span class="w"> </span>story.ssmd-bundle<span class="w"> </span>--profile<span class="w"> </span>narration.renderprofile.toml
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The manifest format determines whether the bundle contains independently planned book items or one document item. A chapter directory, document source file, or arbitrary directory is not an alternate root. UtterPlan reads manifests and source documents but does not modify them.</p>
<section id="manifest-kinds">
<h2>Manifest kinds</h2>
<p>Both supported manifests use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">schema_version:</span> <span class="pre">1</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ssmd_version:</span> <span class="pre">&quot;0.9&quot;</span></code>.</p>
<p>A book manifest declares <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">format:</span> <span class="pre">&quot;ssmdconvert.book&quot;</span></code> and a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">chapters</span></code> array. Every chapter has a unique <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">id</span></code>, positive <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source_number</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">title</span></code>, and normalized relative POSIX <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">path</span></code>; optional hashes are informational and do not override the current source content. Chapter paths are resolved within the bundle root.</p>
<p>A document manifest declares <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">format:</span> <span class="pre">&quot;ssmdconvert.document&quot;</span></code> and one <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">document</span></code> object containing an <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">id</span></code>, relative <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">path</span></code>, and document metadata. Its current source is compiled as one FlowPlan. The bundle’s name does not select its kind: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">manifest.json</span></code> is authoritative.</p>
</section>
<section id="compile">
<h2>Compile</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>utterplan<span class="w"> </span>bundle<span class="w"> </span>compile<span class="w"> </span>novel.ssmd-bundle<span class="w"> </span>--chapters<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">5</span>-17
utterplan<span class="w"> </span>bundle<span class="w"> </span>compile<span class="w"> </span>story.ssmd-bundle<span class="w"> </span>--text-preparation<span class="w"> </span>identity
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Compilation defaults to all items. For book bundles, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--chapters</span></code> selects manifest <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source_number</span></code> values: one number, an inclusive range, or comma-separated combinations such as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">1,3-5,9</span></code>. Selected items retain manifest order. A document bundle accepts only <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--chapters</span> <span class="pre">all</span></code>.</p>
<p>By default, one schema-v7 <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.utterplan.toml</span></code> plan per selected item and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">compile-report.toml</span></code> are written under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;bundle&gt;/utterplan/</span></code>. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--output-dir</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--report</span></code> override those destinations. Existing plans are protected unless <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--force</span></code> is supplied; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--fail-fast</span></code> records later selected items as skipped after a failure. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--language</span></code> is a fallback for SSMD language metadata. Bundle sources are SSMD 0.9, so the command does not accept an input-format override. The report is operational metadata and does not affect plan identity.</p>
</section>
<section id="render">
<h2>Render</h2>
<p>Compilation and rendering are separate operations. Rendering reads saved plans and requires an explicit RenderProfile:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>utterplan<span class="w"> </span>bundle<span class="w"> </span>render<span class="w"> </span>novel.ssmd-bundle<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--chapters<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">5</span>-17<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--profile<span class="w"> </span>narration.renderprofile.toml
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The default RenderPlan root is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;bundle&gt;/renderplan/</span></code>. Each variant includes a canonical <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">renderprofile.toml</span></code> snapshot, RenderPlan artifacts, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">render-report.toml</span></code>; book variants also maintain <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">renderplan-set.toml</span></code> as the active collection index. The variant directory combines a readable label with the RenderProfile identity fingerprint. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--variant</span></code> changes the label without removing the fingerprint. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--utterplan-dir</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--output-root</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--report</span></code> override their respective locations.</p>
<p>Role coverage is checked before new variant artifacts are written. The selected profile must cover every required logical role, including its default role when any speech has no explicit role. Profile identity mismatches, unsafe paths, and metadata collisions are not bypassed by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--force</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="replan">
<h2>Replan</h2>
<p>When VoiceRender reports <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">preflight.replan</span></code>, refine the active plan using its exact matching feedback:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>utterplan<span class="w"> </span>bundle<span class="w"> </span>replan<span class="w"> </span>novel.ssmd-bundle<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--variant<span class="w"> </span>narration--28f616b6fe3b<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--chapters<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">5</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The full variant directory name, including its profile fingerprint, is required. Replanning reads the stored profile snapshot and active plan references, validates preflight feedback against the active RenderPlan, writes deterministic child plans, and updates only selected active references. It refuses stale parent feedback; run VoiceRender again on the newly active plan before another refinement. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--dry-run</span></code> validates and reports planned changes without writing child RenderPlans or changing active references. The single-file <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">render-plan</span> <span class="pre">--previous</span> <span class="pre">...</span> <span class="pre">--preflight</span> <span class="pre">...</span></code> interface remains available for low-level projection and refinement.</p>
</section>
<section id="safe-and-read-only-behavior">
<h2>Safe and read-only behavior</h2>
<p>The bundle path must be a directory named <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;name&gt;.ssmd-bundle</span></code> containing a regular <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">manifest.json</span></code>. Manifest item paths must be normalized relative POSIX paths, remain inside the resolved root, and resolve to regular files. Symlink escapes and unsafe output collisions are rejected. Manifest size and document size are bounded. Source digests are not used to replace current edited content; the manifest and source files are never refreshed or rewritten.</p>
</section>
<section id="python-api">
<h2>Python API</h2>
<p>The public services share the manifest dispatch and selection behavior used by the CLI:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">utterplan</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">compile_bundle</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">replan_bundle</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">render_bundle</span>

<span class="n">compiled</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">compile_bundle</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;novel.ssmd-bundle&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chapters</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;5-17&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">projected</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">render_bundle</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;novel.ssmd-bundle&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">profile</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;narration.renderprofile.toml&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">chapters</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;5-17&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">compiled</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">kind</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="n">projected</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">kind</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;book&quot;</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">compiled</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exit_code</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="n">projected</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exit_code</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">projected</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">variant</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">compile_bundle()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">render_bundle()</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">replan_bundle()</span></code> accept paths and keyword options. Their result records expose the resolved bundle, kind, selection, per-item outcomes, artifact paths, reports, and exit status. Optional progress and start callbacks receive typed records; services do not print. Invalid or unsafe requests raise <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">BundleServiceError</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">BundleReplanError</span></code>, while item-level failures are returned in result outcomes.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
